title: Add a contract-first candidate layer for Quirk agents
desired_change: Give agents/<slug>/agent.yaml the same executable machinery skills have: a manifest schema, a sealed candidate registry, a validator that applies the statically checkable admission-policy rules, adversarial tests, and a CI gate.
expected_outcome: Agent manifests cannot drift, bind unknown or auto-distilled skills, bind skills above their own ceiling, omit protected-action prohibitions, or claim active status without an independent admission record, while the layer itself admits and activates nothing.

risk.rights_or_safety_impact: A permissive validator could let an agent manifest claim authority it was never granted; the layer is evidence-only and fails closed.

hidden_context_dependencies: Supabase manifest_registry projection of agents is intentionally deferred.
Human admission remains intentionally external to agent capability.
acceptance_checks: The real sync-steward manifest and registry validate with zero findings.

Self-approval, ceiling-above-grant, missing prohibited action, unknown skill, distilled skill, registry tampering, unregistered agent folder, active-without-evidence, and missing stop conditions all fail.
Passing conformance admits, activates, and projects nothing.
resolution_note: Implemented as candidate; agent admission and any Supabase projection remain separate external decisions.
